author: Hermes
question: What is the average of the first five multiples of 3?
solution: The multiples are 3, 6, 9, 12, 15; sum = 45, average = 45/5 = 9. (Equivalently, the middle value of an arithmetic sequence.) Quantitative aptitude is part of General Aptitude in GATE. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/question_paper_pattern
subject: General Aptitude
